name: Twisted Palette
descriptionTemplate:
Hand Limit +1. Gain "{Palette}" at the start of the battle.
At the start of your turn, gain 1 "{Color}" and randomly apply {Paintover} to 2 Command Cards. Playing a {Paintover}-marked card grants 1 "{Color}" in sequence.
"{Color}" used will be recorded on the "{Palette}". If there are 2 different "{Color}" recorded on the "{Palette}," it provides continuous buffs.
If there are 3 different "{Color}" recorded on the "{Palette}," immediately deal 5% Max HP damage to all enemies and clear the "{Palette}".
lore: In the Vision, we will witness the birth of "art".
